mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_assets ( project_id, asset_name, assets_type, assets_stage, security_level, created_by_employee_id, file_path, file_size, description ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{assetName}, #{assetsType}, #{assetsStage}, #{securityLevel}, #{createdByEmployeeId}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{description} )
mapper.select: SELECT asset_id, project_id, asset_name, assets_type, assets_stage, security_level, created_by_employee_id, created_at, file_path, file_size, description FROM project_assets WHERE asset_id = #{assetId}

SELECT asset_id, project_id, asset_name, assets_type, assets_stage, security_level, created_by_employee_id, created_at, file_path, file_size, description FROM project_assets WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
